items.title: Colombia earthquake: amateurs on the air, keep Region 2 emergency freqs clear
items.blurb: After the 10 August quake and aftershocks, LCRA emergency coordinator HK6F reports clubs restoring repeaters on solar and batteries, including Liga Radio Quindío heading to Cerro Campanario at 3,600 m. Asociación de Radioaficionados del Eje Cafetero had amateur and shared-site repeaters back up in about 15 minutes after generator transfer failed. IARU R2 emergency coordinator CO2JC asks stations to stay off 3985, 7060, 7240, 7275, 14300, and 21360 kHz, plus 146.520 MHz in VHF range of Colombia.

items.title: ARISS radios down today for the USOS spacewalk
items.blurb: ANS-228 (16 August) has ARISS powered down from 17 August 19:05 UTC through 19 August 10:45 UTC for a U.S. Orbital Segment EVA by Anil Menon and Sophie Adenot KJ5LTN. Columbus crossband repeater stays 145.990 MHz up (PL 67) / 437.800 MHz down when it is back. Zvezda’s Kenwood D710GA (RSØISS) is still in troubleshooting, APRS on 437.825 MHz. School contacts ran 12 August (Challenger conference via NA1SS / KJ5LTN) and 14 August (Australian Air League via OR4ISS / KJ5NIV).

items.title: ARRL National Convention at Huntsville, 21–23 August
items.blurb: Friday 21 August is Training Tracks and luncheon at the Embassy Suites: Mini Contest University (K3LR / DX Engineering), Emergency Communications Academy, and Salty Walt K4OGO portable antennas. Dinner is under the Saturn V at the U.S. Space & Rocket Center. Hamfest itself is Saturday–Sunday at the Von Braun Center South Hall, including W1AW America250. Convention program and hamfest tickets are sold separately.

items.title: RI1FJL/MM: storm, drift, and a dead FT-891 toward Franz Josef Land
items.blurb: RUDXT left Murmansk 12 August as RI1FJL/MM bound for Heiss Island. A 17 August 1345Z note put them in LQ27, about 250 miles out, fog, 30 m CW added. Vasily R7AL later said a heavy north wind (to 19 knots, 5–6 m seas) has the yacht on staysail only. They are off the air /MM because the FT-891 died. Last grid before the failure was LQ37.

items.title: OJ0JR and OJ0YL QRV on Märket Reef through 22 August
items.blurb: Henri OJ0JR and Anne OJ0YL are on Märket Reef 15–22 August, 80–10 m CW, SSB, and FT8, FTdx10 plus K3S and an SPE 1.3K-FA. Jari OH6BG reports they are already on 30 m. Club Log live if the path holds, otherwise several updates a day, OQRS after. QSL OJ0JR via OH3JR, OJ0YL via OH2YL.

items.title: FCC cites GMRS licensee for internet-linked repeater network
items.blurb: Enforcement Bureau Notice of Violation to Gary M. Beckstedt Sr., GMRS WQYU407 (also ham WB4GMB), for linking nearly two dozen North Georgia GMRS repeaters over the internet. Agents in February heard the same traffic on multiple outputs, a §95.1749 problem. GMRS has eight repeater pairs; linking is allowed on amateur, not GMRS, except for remote control. He has 20 days to explain and say what he fixed.

items.title: IARU fourth edition of Ethics and Operating Procedures
items.blurb: IARU published the fourth edition on 14 August, with updated worldwide operating guidance and better access for visually impaired readers. RSGB’s Operating Advisory Service coordinator Ian Suart GM4AUP was among the contributors. The society points members at the RSGB operating-procedures page for the new book.
